description: Gripper Gen 8: merge Grabette's finger connection interface with the Generalist-style Gen 6. Jake (voice): 'On this Grabette, what does the actual connection interface to the two grippers look like? I'd like to take some ideas from this and some ideas from our current Generalist hand, so maybe we could make that Gen 8.' Depends on Gen 6 (voice-650be16a, Generalist copy, reference photos in cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_*.png) and Gen 7 (Grabette copy). Combine: Grabette's finger mount/pivot/drive interface + Gen 6's finger shapes, cutouts, top-mounted drive and camera, clear thumb-index web, and the three straps. Wait for Gen 6 and Gen 7 to land before building; explain which ideas came from which.

results.notes: Jake (voice) CORRECTION, replaces everything above: 'Gen 8 should just be exactly the Grabette files assembled into what looks like the Grabette, so I can view it and explode it.' Gen 8 = Pollen's actual Grabette meshes from https://github.com/pollen-robotics/grabette (Apache-2.0; STLs are in Git LFS, so run git lfs pull; the URDF assets are under packages/grabette/urdf/; the Onshape CAD is linked from the README), assembled as the real Grabette, shown in the design viewer with exploded-view support. No merging with Generalist or Gen 6/7, and no redesign. Keep their license and notice with the files. .

Note: Gen 7 changed. It is now just the yellow fingers matched to Generalist, not a Grabette copy. For Gen 8, take the finger connection interface straight from the Grabette repo (https://github.com/pollen-robotics/grabette, Apache-2.0) and combine it with the Gen 7 fingers and the Gen 6 body ideas. .

summary: Gen 8 should be Pollen Robotics' actual Grabette meshes from their GitHub repo, assembled as the real Grabette with no merging or redesign. It should open in the design viewer with exploded-view support, and keep Apache-2.0 license and notice files alongside.
